_definitions.source: common evaluator step3_eval.py + step3_metrics.py (impl), aggregated by verifier analyze.py from rows
_definitions.min_clearance_mm_<w>: per chunk min over steps < W and spheres of our TO clearance (record contact policy, per-step served finger); summarized over chunks (median, p5, min)
_definitions.tcp_disp_mm_<w>: TCP = mean of manipulating hand finger spheres; mean_of_chunk_mean = mean over chunks of the per-chunk mean ||tcp - tcp_ref||; max = max over chunks of the per-chunk max
_definitions.n_<vel|acc|pos>_violation_steps_<w>: total_steps = sum over chunks of violating steps; n_chunks_with_any
_definitions.solve_ms: warm wall ms (cuRobo: host perf_counter + cuda.synchronize, GPU H200; to_recorded: record to.solve_ms, server CPU live; to_resolved: this machine CPU offline, 4 parallel workers). cold separated
_definitions.n_solver_failure: cuRobo success=false; our TO status violated/solver_failed (status_counts lists the statuses)
_definitions.TO-active: recorded refined vs reference TCP > 1 mm anywhere in plan16
_definitions.paired_vs_to_recorded_exec8: per chunk, candidate exec8 min clearance vs to_recorded exec8 min clearance

evaluator_fidelity.definition: evaluator min over the 8 executed steps of the recorded refined_chunk vs the record's summary.to.metrics.clearance_m (what our TO certified)

curobo_run.solver_order: candidate-outer, one solver alive at a time

order_dependence_vs_impl_smoke_r3.definition: max |q_full_run - q_impl_smoke_r3| over 50x14 (rad), same candidate, same chunk; full run = all 750 chunks in fixed order, smoke = 8 chunks (ep126, ep211 positions 0,20,40,60)
